<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmationAndSelfies" name="Character confirmation and selfies"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a character">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToParallel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Set up account and think of names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToParallel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelToThinkNames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" name="Have a Battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountInformationToConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the confirmation email link">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountInformationToConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmationToAccountJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountJoin" name="Continue with Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmationToAccountJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountJoinToSubscriptionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountJoinToSubscriptionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionActive</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoActiveSubscription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoActiveSubscription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Choose payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCardToPaymentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBankDetails" name="Enter IBAN and BIC">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentJoin" name="Continue after subscription check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionActive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCardToPaymentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentJoinToLogin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LoginAndSelectCharacterOptions" name="Log in and select realm, race, and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentJoinToLogin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoginToParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames" name="Think of character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelToThinkNames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin" name="Account ready and names thought of">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoginToParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoinToEnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter a character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoinToEnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check name availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies" name="Receive confirmation and character selfies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmationToReleaseWait</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ConfirmationAndSelfies" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndSelfies"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage" name="Receive message when the expansion is released">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmationToReleaseWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReleaseMessageToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CharacterGeneratorComplete" name="Character creation messages received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReleaseMessageToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToParallel" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToThinkNames" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountInformationToConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToAccountJoin" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountJoinToSubscriptionCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionActive" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">activeSubscription = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoActiveSubscription" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">activeSubscription = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "credit card"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterBankDetails">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "bank account"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCardToPaymentJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnterBankDetails" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentJoinToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentJoin" targetRef="Task_LoginAndSelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_LoginAndSelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoinToEnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesJoin" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" name="Available" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable" name="Unavailable; try another name" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToReleaseWait" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmationAndSelfies" targetRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReleaseMessageToEnd" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveExpansionMessage" targetRef="EndEvent_CharacterGeneratorComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmationEmail" name="Account confirmation email"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CharacterConfirmationAndSelfies" name="Character confirmation and selfies"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionRelease" name="Expansion release message"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterCreation" name="Create a World of Warcraft character" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start creating a character">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToParallel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartParallel" name="Set up account and come up with names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToParallel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelToThinkNames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" name="Have a Battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountInfoToEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveConfirmationEmail" name="Receive the confirmation email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountInfoToEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmailToClickLink</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ConfirmationEmail" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationEmail"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the confirmation email link">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmailToClickLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClickLinkToAccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountMerge" name="Continue with a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClickLinkToAccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMergeToSubscriptionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMergeToSubscriptionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Have an active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionActive</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoActiveSubscription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select a payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoActiveSubscription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Choose payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCardToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBankDetails" name="Enter IBAN and BIC">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMerge" name="Continue after payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionActive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCardToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMergeToLogin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log in to the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMergeToLogin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LoginToSelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select realm, race, and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LoginToSelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectOptionsToParallelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelToThinkNames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AccountAndNamesMerge" name="Account set up and names ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectOptionsToParallelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelMergeToEnterName</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter a character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelMergeToEnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check whether the name is available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation" name="Receive character confirmation and selfies">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CharacterConfirmationAndSelfies" messageRef="Message_CharacterConfirmationAndSelfies"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CharacterConfirmationToReleaseWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpansionMessageToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionRelease" messageRef="Message_ExpansionRelease"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CharacterCreationComplete" name="Receive the expansion release message">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpansionMessageToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToParallel" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_StartParallel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToAccountCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToThinkNames" sourceRef="Gateway_StartParallel" targetRef="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccountExists" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMethodToGateway" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "credit card"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterBankDetails">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">paymentMethod = "bank account"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCardToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankDetailsToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBankDetails" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMergeToLogin" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginToSelectCharacterOptions" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectOptionsToParallelMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThinkNamesToParallelMerge" sourceRef="Task_ThinkOfCharacterNames" targetRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelMergeToEnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountAndNamesMerge" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterNameToAvailabilityCheck" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AvailabilityCheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" name="Available" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCharacterConfirmation">
